name: manual_35be0e
claim: Keep PT .agent canonical in v1; route runtime lessons only through provisioned Anamnesis.

decisions.notes: A stable Orama capture controller must not silently create a second memory authority. Development delegates to PT now; runtime fails closed until its private backend is deliberately provisioned, and automatic push remains human-gated.
